categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through prompt payment by the offender, advancing the softgoal 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and helping 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', evaluated against 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' and 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=12, supported by frequent variants such as V0002 and V0007 where payment resolves the fine case quickly without requiring coercive enforcement.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved via payment made after notification or penalties have been applied, contributing to 'Maximize timely fine revenue', measured against 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=13, evidenced by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payments occur after fine notifications and added penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving an administrative appeal submitted to the Prefecture, helping preserve the offender's due-process rights while potentially impacting enforcement costs and revenue, measured against 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=14, supported by variants such as V0008, V0057, and V0135 containing appeal submission and result notification steps.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases where an appeal is brought before a judge, strongly advancing due-process rights but incurring costs and delaying fine revenue, measured against 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=19, evidenced by variants like V0103, V0176, and V0140 containing judicial appeal activities.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases escalated to credit collection due to non-payment, contributing to fine revenue while increasing enforcement costs and negatively affecting due-process softgoals, measured against 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=20, backed by high-frequency and long-duration variants like V0001 and V0009 ending in credit collection dispatch.

categories.name: Resolve via fine annulment
categories.description: Cases concluded through the formal annulment of the issued fine, stopping enforcement procedures.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=187 as specified by the goal model decomposition for case resolution alternatives.
